entries.title: Federal Decree by Law No. (45) of 2021 Concerning the Protection of Personal Data
entries.authority: United Arab Emirates Government, UAE Legislation
entries.scope: Federal personal-data framework, subject to its territorial scope, exclusions and applicable regulations; potentially relevant when education tools process identifiable student or staff data.

entries.summary: The federal law regulates personal-data processing and sets processing controls, individual rights and conditions for transfers, subject to its scope and exceptions.
requirements: Determine whether the law and an exception apply before processing identifiable learner or staff information; identify the relevant processing basis and purpose.
Consider data minimisation, security, data-subject rights and any applicable cross-border transfer conditions when selecting and operating a tool.
limitations: Article 2 excludes government data and government entities processing personal data, certain regulated health and banking data, and free-zone establishments with their own data-protection legislation. Do not assume this federal regime applies to every university.
Article references are starting points, not a complete account of duties, exceptions, implementing rules or later changes; verify the authoritative Arabic text and current instruments.
Current statutory full text, cross-border transfer conditions and applicability to this prototype have not been verified.
